entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, hey, Yusuke.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ann...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Perfect timing.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? Whaddya mean?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I've been working on a way to incorporate[n]beauty into our fights, instead of merely[n]doing away with our enemies each time...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And only a moment ago, I was struck[n]with a bolt of inspiration.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ah, is that right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So... what did you mean by "perfect[n]timing," then?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, yes—so my potential idea is good[n]and all, but I'll require your help to[n]pull it off.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Would you please lend me a hand?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sure, but, uh... nothing too weird,[n]alright?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Have no fear.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oooh...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That totally sounds like something[n]you'd come up with, Yusuke!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Of course, if you have no interest,[n]you're in no way obligated to help...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No no, it sounds awesome!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, but—what if we tried doing this[n]beforehand?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Oho...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We should definitely incorporate that[n]into the attack. I never would've come[n]up with that part on my own.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Awesome! I can't wait!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Actually... I want to try it right now[n]as well!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I truly hope the Star will grant us this...
